**Updated Understanding:**
The beaker has water droplets on its outside bottom, and those droplets freeze. Freezing is an exothermic phase change (ΔH_fus ≈ −334 J/g released). Near the beaker wall at quasi-steady conditions, set q_reaction (from inside) + q_freezing (from the droplets) ≈ 0. Because q_freezing > 0 (heat released to the wall/air), it follows that q_reaction > 0 as well, i.e., the reaction is exothermic and releases energy. Therefore, the correct statement is B.
